limitations: Public-corpus sanity check on a 50,000-profile sample (whole customers sampled, seed 20261022); the full corpus was not evaluated locally. See aurora-eval-harness/datasets/public/uci_online_retail_ii/README.md for the mapping and the pseudonymous loy_id assumption (recall ceiling ~0.64).
notes: Engine scores are normalised from the 0–5 band scale to [0, 1] (score/5); the operating threshold 0.60 is the engine's 3.0 on its own scale.
The threshold sweep re-clusters engine pair scores with plain connected components, so it approximates (does not reproduce) the engine's conflict-aware clustering at other thresholds.
